title: Deep-Cavity Handheld Charging Cradle
description: One original empty handheld charging-cradle visual prop with a true tapered deep cavity, closed thick walls and a solid bearing floor. Two inward guide ribs, a raised rear stop, a floor-mounted contact carrier with two small separate brass contact points, and four finite rubber feet are modeled as ten independently editable closed meshes. Overall 148 x 128 x 82 mm, metres, Z up, floor-centre origin, front -Y. The unblocked central cavity and actual bearing floor are measured from the complete exported geometry. Four solid PBR materials, no textures or external assets. No handheld is included; no previous radio or other device compatibility is tested or claimed. One static prop only; no charging, circuit, battery, voltage, radio communication, insertion animation, manufacture, electrical or product-safety guarantee.
